charts.name: J. Heath & Co. Accountability Chart (proposal)
charts.source: company/traction/Annual/Management/2026-10-29-management-session-report.md (sections 3.8, 4.6 and 10; decisions D1-1 through D1-5, D2-22 through D2-28) and 2026-10-29-management-session-summary-management.md section 5. All structure is PROPOSAL to leadership until the leadership quarterly (week of 2026-11-02). The session redrew only the layer under Operations and Front Desk/Support; Visionary, Integrator, Sales and Marketing and Finance/Administration are carried unchanged from the current chart.

seats.title: Visionary
seats.notes: Not revisited by the session; roles carried from the current chart. Jude's and Jennifer's own seat roles are an open item for leadership ("they can do that themselves", Day 2).

seats.title: Integrator
seats.notes: Not revisited by the session; carried from the current chart. Sixth role over the five-role cap, in the source: Communication across the organization.

seats.title: Sales and Marketing
seats.notes: Carried unchanged; still a shared seat (V6 open). Two further roles in the source: HR / Employee management; Hiring and performance reviews.

seats.title: Finance/Administration
seats.notes: Carried unchanged; still shared by Russell and Jennifer (decisions log 2026-10-19). The session did not revisit it.

seats.title: Front Desk / Support
seats.notes: Kept, with Inventory added as the fifth role (Day 1). Ownership claim ("that part is mine", speaker unresolved) open for leadership. Ashley also becomes the admin communication intermediary: daily unanswered-messages report and weekly missing-info list routed through Xixi (D2-13). Name spelled Ashley in the session sources, Ashely on the EOS One export.

seats.title: Operations
seats.notes: Head left open ("that's a later on decision"): Jennifer Heath (current head) versus Russell Heath. Role list not redrawn; five current Operations roles (client service and retention, training, process implementation, project and software implementation, process management) move to Kayla's seat (D1-1). The four divisions and Kayla's seat sit below this seat; the Day 2 tree was drawn cut off above Operations.

seats.title: Kayla's seat (above the team split)
seats.notes: New seat, "in the middle", above the team split (D1-1); the session gave it no functional name. The tax-return line is removed from this seat (tax-return accountability moves to Jude and Jennifer as team owners). Kayla also oversees the seniors and their WIP/billable monitoring (D2-28) and drops from five WIP meetings to about three.

seats.title: Tax-Jude
roles: Individual marketing plan and business contacts
seats.notes: Xixi's first seat (D1-2): "Senior Tax Accountant and Senior Tax Reviewer" on Jude's team, replacing the "lead preparer = Morgan" construct (informal staff mentoring moves to Tax Staff 2). One standardized senior role shared with Nicole (D2-23, D2-27). Division per D2-24.

seats.title: Tax-Jen
roles: Individual marketing plan and business contacts
seats.notes: Senior under Tax-Jen (D2-24); placement inferred, the transcript garbles the tree line. Nicole flips from about 168 prepared / 25 reviewed to about 140 reviewed plus preparing the 40-50 LOG returns, with Alexis and Sierra tag-teaming the logs; she keeps her complicated clients (D2-22).

seats.title: Accounting-Jude
roles: Interact closely with seniors and supervisors
seats.notes: Accounting lead: Mary in both accounting divisions (D2-24). Reviews all monthly accounting for both sides; printed P&L details go to Jude's desk for his yearly look (D2-26). "Mary" / "Anne-Mary" in the session transcript = Ann Mary Jose.

seats.title: Accounting-Jen
roles: Interact closely with seniors and supervisors
seats.notes: Same lead and role list as Accounting-Jude (D2-24, D2-25). Escalation from the accounting lead goes straight to Jude and Jennifer, not through Kayla (D2-26).

seats.title: Tax Staff 1
roles: Ask questions and don't spin your wheels
seats.notes: Pooled across Tax-Jude and Tax-Jen (D2-24); drawn in a "V" converging on the preparers, so this seed attaches it under Kayla's seat above the split (single-parent tree). Questions route staff 1 -> staff 2 -> senior -> Jude/Jennifer only if needed (D2-26). "Sierra" in the transcript = Sieara Williams.

seats.title: Tax Staff 2
roles: Prepare basic and more complex returns
Support peers and less experienced staff
Ask questions and don't spin your wheels
seats.notes: "Learn" dropped for this level (D2-25); "lead" dropped from all seat names (D1-3). The old Tax Preparer short list is replaced by this lead-preparer list given to all four staff (D2-25, solves I2-20). Informal staff mentoring sits here (Morgan, Mary).

seats.title: Accountant 1
roles: Develop proficiency in QuickBooks Desktop/Online/Xero and the Lacerte equivalent
Learn P&L, balance sheets and reconciliations
Ask questions and don't spin your wheels
seats.notes: Drawn spanning both accounting divisions (D2-24); this seed attaches it under Accounting-Jude because Jude's side has the larger accounting book, but the attachment is an editorial call the builder should mark. Questions route to the accounting lead (Mary), then Jude and Jennifer (D2-26).

seats.title: Post-Processing Admin
seats.notes: D1-5: Debbie is post-processing admin on Jennifer's side (clean-up after all returns are done, invoices, payment processing) and purely the mailer on Jude's side. Layer order: "Jude and Jennifer, then Nicole and Shishi, then everybody else." No role bullets were written for this seat; the session used "Debbie" for Debra Mengel.
